title: infra_migration_capture
description: What the 1.1.1 to 1.2.0 migration copied before it removed anything, kept in spec/extras/migration/capture.json: the values a later judgement step cannot get from the migrated tree, grouped by the work that reads them, and the commit everything else is read from. Written once by the first migration script (migration/scripts/v1_2_0/p1_capture.py); the only later write is the renames section, appended by the script that renames an id. Every value copied from a 1.1.1 file sits under a key that starts with legacy_; the other keys are the capture's own. Committed and tool-owned; not a step artifact and not read by the graph.

source.description: Where the old content can be read again, and what the files were before the run.

commit.description: HEAD of the host when the capture was made (git rev-parse HEAD).

spec_dir.description: The spec folder, relative to the git work tree, with slashes.

show_form.description: The command that prints an old file: git show <commit>:<spec_dir>/<file>.

file_hashes.description: The sha256 of every file of the spec folder before the run (the files under extras/migration/ excepted), by path relative to the spec folder.

milestone_status.description: Status per source, for the legacy close and its conflicts.

roadmap.description: Step 14 milestones[]: status and status reason.

plans.description: One row per plan file: the review verdict (null when the plan has none) and plan.status.

file.description: The file, relative to the spec folder.

review_verdict.description: The verdict of the plan's review (verified or another), null when the plan has no review.

task_status.description: Every task of step 14: status, status reason and the fr_refs and invariant_refs the 1.1.1 task carried.

task_exit_conditions.description: The tasks of step 14 with a non-empty exit_conditions list.

task_assumptions.description: The tasks of step 14 with a non-empty assumptions list.

third_party.description: The tech stacks of steps 02, 09 and 14 and the external components of step 02.

step.description: The step of the file the value was copied from.

legacy_tech_stack.description: The tech_stack object as the file carried it.

tech_stacks.description: One row per step whose file carried a tech_stack.

external_components.description: Components of step 02 with type external, whole except their trace.

component.description: The component_id of the component (null when it had none).

legacy_component.description: The component object as the file carried it, without its trace.

governance.description: The keys of step 10 that are removed or become rules; each present key under its legacy_ name.

plan_security.description: Per plan: the security.spec_mutations and security.new_fixtures entries (a plan that has none is not listed).

file.description: The file, relative to the spec folder.

plan_items.description: Per plan item id: the fields a later step removes (a plan item that has none is not listed).

file.description: The file, relative to the spec folder.

item.description: The id of the plan item (a plan.spec_alignment.checklist[] entry).

legacy_linked_test_expectation.description: The linked_test_expectation of the item (a string or a list).

milestone_ordering.description: Milestone ordering that no 1.2.0 field stores: the step-09 depends_on lists, every typed dependency of steps 09 and 14, the dependency_ref objects.

milestone.description: The milestone id as the file spelled it.

legacy_depends_on.description: The depends_on list of the milestone.

pairs.description: One row per step-09 milestone that carried a depends_on list.

step.description: The step of the file the value was copied from.

legacy_dependency.description: The dependency entry as the file carried it.

typed_dependencies.description: Every entry of the top-level dependencies of steps 09 and 14, with its type.

step.description: The step of the file the value was copied from.

dependency_refs.description: The dependency_ref object of steps 09 and 14.

milestone_links.description: Per milestone of step 09, step 14 and the anchor: the source milestones, deliverables, fr_refs, capability_refs and context_path the 1.1.1 file carried.

step.description: The step of the file the value was copied from.

milestone.description: The milestone id as the file spelled it.

legacy_fr_refs.description: The fr_refs of the milestone, anchor row or task.

legacy_context_path.description: The context_path of the anchor row.

ambiguities.description: The ambiguity items of the anchor and of the plans that are not resolved, whole (impact included); resolved items are not copied.

file.description: The file, relative to the spec folder.

step.description: The step of the file the value was copied from.

legacy_item.description: The ambiguity item whole, as the file carried it.

environment_host_keys.description: The environments of step 02a, each whole; the host keys that no node field takes are among them.

environment.description: The environment name (dev, ci, staging, prod).

legacy_environment.description: The environment object whole, as the file carried it.

renames.description: The definitions phase 2 gave a new id (a collision), written by the script that renamed them in the same run. The sections above key old 1.1.1 records by the id they had when the capture was made: a reader maps an old id to its new one through this list. Optional: absent until a rename happens.

kind.description: The kind of the renamed node (criterion, design-milestone, ...).

file.description: The file that holds the renamed definition.

path.description: A path relative to the spec folder, with slashes.

milestone.description: The milestone id as the file spelled it.

legacy_status.description: The status the milestone or task carried.

milestone.description: The milestone id as the file spelled it.

legacy_status.description: The status the milestone or task carried.

legacy_fr_refs.description: The fr_refs of the milestone, anchor row or task.
